component.name: TinyDock
component.summary: Lightweight elastic dock with hover zoom for GTK3 desktops

description.p: TinyDock is a lightweight bottom dock for GTK3 Linux desktops (Cinnamon, MATE, Xfce, GNOME). It features an elastic hover-zoom on icons, minimal window-state indicator dots, and a bundled analog clock widget (tclock).
Window state is polled via libwnck-3 and works under X11 sessions.
